terms.ampersand: the symbol & used to represent a pointer to a variable
terms.getchar: reads the next character from standard input
terms.header: a file containing declarations that are included by other files
terms.input: data entered by the user or received from a device
terms.output: data sent to the screen or file by a program
terms.printf: sends formatted data to the standard output stream
terms.putchar: writes the specified character to standard output
terms.scanf: reads formatted data from the standard input stream
terms.stdio: standard input/output library for handling data streams
terms.value: the current data held within a variable
terms.variable: a named location in memory that holds a data value
